title: Carum carvi essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Carum carvi essential oil is derived from the flowering plant Carum carvi, commonly known as caraway. This essential oil is widely used in herbalism for its digestive and carminative properties. It is often employed to relieve symptoms such as bloating, gas, and indigestion. The oil can be used in aromatherapy or diluted in a carrier oil for topical application. In traditional medicine, it is also believed to support respiratory health and ease menstrual discomfort.
